calculation.description: Multiply trailing 20-day close return by the asymmetry between RMS positive and RMS negative daily returns. Positive values favor momentum supported by larger upside moves and penalize downside-dominated momentum; all inputs use information available at the signal date.

validation.method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC; minimum 8 valid instruments; 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in all three regimes; uncertainty remains material because the cross-section is only 15 assets, although validation spans 1844 dates.
